name: Yuanhao Bai
institution: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
education: B.Eng. in Safety Engineering, Central South University, expected June 2027
tagline: Resource-aware intelligence for distributed embedded systems.
about: I am a Research Assistant at HKUST(GZ), working on distributed and resource-aware AI systems. My research explores how constrained devices and robot collectives can learn, coordinate, and act in the physical world.
interests: Multi-agent reinforcement learning, distributed AI, TinyML, and multimodal sensing.
vision: Research in multi-agent reinforcement learning, distributed and resource-aware AI systems, TinyML, and multimodal sensing.
availability: Interested in PhD opportunities and research collaborations in distributed and resource-aware AI systems.
